Whether it's Leonardo da Vinci and Michelangelo from the Renaissance, Rubens and Caravaggio from the Baroque period, or Monet and Degas from the Impressionist period, we have them all!

Of course, if you love Asian art, we also have ukiyo-e prints by Katsushika Hokusai and Utagawa Hiroshige, as well as Fan Kuan's ""Travelers Among Mountains and Streams"" and Huang Gongwang's ""Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains"".

Art is not far away from us. We don't want the glass display cases in museums to be obstacles to your love of art. We provide you with high-definition images so that you can appreciate the details and techniques of each painting up close. You can also download these high-definition images directly and enjoy these art treasures anytime, anywhere, making your life full of artistic atmosphere. 

In order to let you have a deeper understanding of art, we have carefully prepared explanatory content for each painting, allowing you to understand the story behind it while appreciating the painting!

By downloading this app, you will enjoy:
- Daily recommended high-definition images of world-famous paintings, which can be viewed or downloaded anytime, anywhere


- 15 paintings updated every week, accepting suggestions from every user to meet your artistic taste

- Explore the outstanding art collections of the top ten museums in the world, such as the Louvre and the British Museum

- Join our art club and get the latest updates of the app

- Carefully designed widget function, allowing you to appreciate art anytime, anywhere

- Support for light and dark modes



Contact us:
- If you are passionate about art, welcome to join our community to discuss art! You can also join our development team to create a better art appreciation experience together.


- If you are an art-related practitioner, we also welcome cooperation with you to bring more artistic perspectives to users.


- Email: askrsw@qq.com
